name: 85308 · Glendale, AZ
findings: ZIP 85308 (Glendale) has 205 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85308 (Glendale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
